IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair wears a navy cropped V-neck knit with red
raglan sleeves, cream stripes at the shoulders, and
a large red letter S with a script detail on the chest.
Her hands rest at her sides. Dark low-rise wash
jeans. Her expression is calm and direct. A plain
white backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of
navy, crimson, and cream. Collegiate and sporty, in
the style of a college knitwear catalog.
